items.title: How to Keep Your Backpack Clean (and Looking New All Year)
items.summary: Backpacks go through a lot in a school year. They sit on classroom floors, ride in cars and buses, carry water bottles, hold half-finished snacks, and somehow collect crumbs in pockets you barely use. The good news: keeping a backpack clean does not have to be complicated. With a few simple habits, regular spot checks, and the right care routine, you can help your backpack stay fresh from the first day of school through the last. And when you start with a washable, well-organized Vera Bradley backpack, everyday messes are much easier to manage. Start With a Weekly Backpack Cleanout The easiest way to keep a backpack clean is to stop little messes from becoming bigger ones. Once a week, empty every compartment and shake out crumbs, scraps of paper, pencil shavings, receipts, wrappers, and anything else that has settled at the bottom. Shop the Large Bancroft Backpack Check smaller pockets, too. Pens, lip balm, snacks, sticky notes, and loose change are easy to forget, but they are often the source of stains, smells, and clutter. 💡 Pro Tip: It can be hard to keep track of all the little things you might need every day. Try a small pouch or two to hold those extras in your backpack. Having them all zipped in one place makes them easy to find, plus it’s a breeze to pull out the pouch when it’s cleanout time. Keep Food and Drinks Contained Snacks and water bottles are usually the biggest backpack mess-makers. Use a lunch bag or reusable container instead of dropping food directly into a backpack pocket. For water bottles, use exterior side pockets whenever possible so leaks are less likely to spread to books, papers, or your laptop. This is where backpack design matters. Styles with side bottle pockets, zip compartments, and interior organization make it easier to separate school supplies, snacks, tech, and personal items. 💡 Pro Tip: Hydration is great. A loose water bottle rolling around inside your bag? Not so much. Look for a backpack like Vera Bradley’s Large Bancroft Backpack which has a side pocket with elastic and a pleat to fit a variety of different-sized bottles. Store Pens, Pencils, and Small Supplies An uncapped pen can do a lot of damage in a backpack. Keep writing tools in a pencil pouch or dedicated pocket instead of loose in the main compartment. Choose a backpack that has pen slips, zip pockets, and interior compartments to keep smaller supplies from rolling around. Bonus: you know exactly where your pen is when you need it! Shop Vera Bradley Backpacks Choose Easy-to-Clean Materials Some backpack messes are unavoidable but the right material can make cleanup a lot easier. When you’re shopping for a school backpack, look for fabrics that are designed to handle everyday use and are easy to clean when life gets messy. And always follow the manufacturer’s recommended cleaning instructions when it comes time for a refresh. Vera Bradley’s backpacks not only look great, they are a durable, practical pick. In fact, our quilted Premium Cotton backpacks can actually be tossed in the washing machine to take off that mid-school year grime. Follow these steps to keep your backpack looking like new: How to Clean a Vera Bradley Backpack 1. Before washing your quilted cotton Vera Bradley backpack, empty it completely. Check every pocket, remove loose items, and shake out crumbs or debris. 2. Close all zippers and closures before placing the bag in the washing machine. 3. Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. 4. Line dry or lay your backpack flat to dry to help maintain its shape. Have a Featherweight backpack? Skip the washing machine – clean stains with a soft, damp cloth and gentle detergent, then rinse thoroughly and lay flat to dry. How Often Should You Clean Your Backpack? For backpacks that get everyday use, a little routine maintenance goes a long way. Do a quick cleanout once a week and spot clean any spills or stains that pop up. If your backpack is machine washable, do a more thorough wash cycle each semester to remove lingering odors and start fresh. Empty it, organize it, wipe what needs wiping, and wash when needed. That is the simplest way to keep your backpack looking newer for longer! A Great Day Starts With a Clean Backpack Your backpack carries your whole day. Choosing a washable, thoughtfully-designed backpack makes it easier to handle real-life messes without letting them take over. With regular cleanouts, smart packing habits, and the right care routine, your backpack can stay fresh, organized, and ready for whatever the school year brings! SHOP ALL SCHOOL BACKPACKS

items.title: How to Personalize Your Backpack Your Way
items.summary: You already know what you like. You don't need anyone telling you what works. But there's something especially satisfying about taking a bag you love using every day and giving it just enough of your personality to feel different. Maybe that looks like a clean monogrammed backpack that feels polished and personal at the same time. Maybe it's a few well-placed backpack decorations that add texture, movement, or a little humor. Maybe it changes week to week, depending on your mood. If you've ever wondered how to decorate a backpack without ruining the structure, overwhelming the design, or committing to something you'll regret later, you're in the right place! Your Favorite Backpack That Holds It All If your day includes a laptop, a water bottle, a charger, notebooks, and at least three "just in case" items, the Bancroft Backpack is your bag. It's built for real life: • A padded laptop compartment (fits up to 15”) that actually protects your tech. • Two main zip compartments, so everything isn't fighting for space. • A front pocket with built-in organization (four slip pockets and a pen slot) so you're not digging for basics. • Two exterior slip pockets, including one that flexes to fit different water bottles. • A trolley sleeve that makes travel days easier, not harder. Make it yours: Start with a monogram if you want something permanent and polished. Then layer in function and personality: • Clip on the Zip Earbud Bag Charm, so your earbuds are always within reach (and not buried at the bottom of the bag). • Add a cute Backpack Bag Charm for a playful finishing touch. A Smaller Style for Lighter Days The Small Banbury Backpack may not pack a punch in terms of size, but it still shows up prepared. What makes it work: • Two zip compartments to keep your essentials separated (and easy to find). • A back slip pocket for quick-grab items like your phone. • Side pockets that quietly add extra function without bulk. • Interior pockets that keep everything from turning into one big pile. It's compact, but not limiting. Clean, but not boring. Make it yours: This is where monogrammed backpacks really shine. The smaller silhouette makes a monogram feel intentional, not overwhelming. Then keep personalization simple: • Add the Beaded Shell Bag Charm for texture and movement. • Or go with the Bitty Bear Bag Charm if you want something softer and a little unexpected. Throw it Over Your Shoulder With Style Our Lorman Sling Backpack is built for movement. Whether you're commuting, traveling, or just out for the day, it keeps everything close without slowing you down. What makes it different: • A streamlined, body-hugging shape that stays comfortable all day. • An adjustable strap (up to 44”), so you can wear it your way. • Two zip compartments + an exterior slip pocket for quick, easy access. • An interior zip pocket for smaller valuables. It's efficient. It's lightweight. It doesn't ask for attention, but it gets it. Make it yours: With a silhouette this clean, personalization should feel deliberate. • Clip on the Bitty Bear Bag Charm in a different pattern for contrast. Something soft against a sleek shape. • Or keep it practical with the Zip Earbud Bag Charm, so your essentials stay right where you need them. This is the minimalist approach to personalized bags: one or two small details, placed well. Little Details, Big Personality Decorative accessories can be practical, playful, or a little bit of both. The right bag charm adds personality to your backpack while giving you an easy way to switch things up whenever the mood strikes. Zip Earbud Bag Charm This is one of those stylish functional charms that quietly improves your routine. What it does well: • Holds most standard earbud cases, including wireless styles. • Keeps them protected with a secure zip closure. • Attaches easily with a hinge ring, so you can clip it exactly where it makes sense for you. Specs at a glance: • 3.25" wide x 2.75" high x 2" deep How to use it when you're thinking about how to decorate a backpack: Clip it near the top or side of your bag where you naturally reach. It's so easy it will quickly become part of your routine. Personalization tip: Pair a Leather Zip Earbud Bag Charm with a quilted cotton backpack to mix and match materials. Bancroft Backpack Bag Charm This bag charm adds something playful when your bag feels a little too plain. What makes it different: • A mini backpack design that mirrors the real thing. • A working zip pocket that's small, but usable. • A sturdy shape that doesn't collapse or lose structure over time. • Hinge ring attachment for easy repositioning. Specs at a glance: 3.5" wide x 2.5" high x 1.5" deep How to style it: Attach it to a front-facing zipper or side ring, so it's visible, but not competing. It adds dimension, especially on more structured bags like the Bancroft. It's subtle, but it changes the whole feel. Personalization tip: The Original Tote Bag Charm is another great way to show off your favorite Vera Bradley style and patterns in a fun super-mini way. Bitty Bear Bag Charm There's a reason this one works; it softens everything around it. What makes it stand out: • A lightweight, soft construction that moves naturally with your bag. • A 6" cord loop that makes it easy to attach to zippers, straps, or rings. • Enough detail to feel intentional, not novelty. Specs at a glance: 4" wide x 3.75" high How to use it: Pair it with a more structured bag to create contrast. If your backpack leans polished or minimal, this adds just enough personality without undoing the look. It's one of the easiest ways personalize your backpack without committing to anything permanent. Beaded Shell Bag Charm This charm brings soft texture and a coastal-inspired feel to your backpack, adding a small but thoughtful detail that feels personal without overpowering the bag. What makes it special: • Hand-beaded detailing, so there's depth and subtle variation. • A slight weight that gives it movement without feeling heavy. • A leash clip attachment that stays secure but is easy to reposition. Specs at a glance: 3.25" wide x 4.75" high (including clip) How to style it: This works best when you let it stand alone. It doesn't need competition. Clip it onto a clean silhouette and let the texture do the work. If you're figuring out how to decorate a backpack without adding clutter, this is your move. Personalization, Without the Panic If you've ever wondered how to decorate a backpack and immediately worried about ruining it, you're not alone. Here's how to make it yours without second-guessing: • Use built-in hardware like rings and zipper pulls. • Stick with removable accessories so your style can shift with you. • Choose professional monogramming options for a clean, lasting finish. • Avoid overcrowding one area. Balance always looks more intentional. • Let the design do its part. You don't have to add everything at once. It's Not Just a Backpack. It's Yours! There's no one "right" way to decorate your backpack, and that's exactly why it works. Some days, it's a monogram that makes your backpack feel polished and personal. Other days, it's a charm or two that adds playful movement and a little something extra. Start with a bag that already works for your life and then add details that feel like a natural extension of you, not an afterthought. A few thoughtful touches can turn everyday bags into personalized backpacks that feel more considered, more functional, and more you, without compromising quality or style. SHOP PERSONALIZED BACKPACKS AND BAGS

items.title: The Best Bags to Carry Everything She Needs for After-School Activities
items.summary: We know school life can be chaotic. And honestly, that's where the magic lives. It's sneakers and ballet slippers on the same day. It's math homework wedged between rehearsals. It's snacks in the car, quick changes in the backseat, and a schedule that might change every day. The right bag doesn't try to simplify her life into one lane. It moves with her, holding it all together without getting in the way, without asking her to choose between style and function. Because she's not choosing, she's doing it all! For Those Days That Don't Pack Light There's a moment (usually in the middle of an already busy week) when the list of what she needs feels… ambitious. Extra shoes. A change of clothes. Water bottle. Warm-up gear. Maybe a costume piece or two. This is where lightweight yet roomy duffel bags quietly become essential. The Large Original Duffel is built for exactly those moments: • A roomy interior that doesn't make you play favorites with what comes along. • Three interior slip pockets that keep smaller essentials from disappearing into the void. • Exterior side and front pockets for the things you need right now (phone, lip balm, hair ties). • Soft, durable quilted cotton that holds up to daily use, yet still feels like something you actually want to carry. It's the kind of bag that easily transitions from gym to studio to wherever she's headed next. Which is why it's a natural fit for dance bags for girls and just as perfect for sports practices that require a little (or a lot) of everything. "This duffel is sturdy, spacious, and so cute!" ~ Emma Big Days Call For Big Bag Energy Some days aren't local. The Adair Rolling Duffel is designed for those bigger moments: • Smooth-rolling wheels and a telescoping handle make navigating busy spaces easier. • A structured design that stands upright (because balance matters, even off the stage). • Plenty of storage spaces with zip pockets inside and out to keep everything in its place. • Lightweight durability that holds up through travel days, competitions, and repeat performances. It's the bag that takes some of the weight off, literally and mentally, so she can focus on what she came to do. Pro tip: Convenient storage pouches are her best friend when it comes to bigger bags, whether for after school or tournament travel. Keep hair accessories, makeup and more organized and easy to reach. Our Large Original Duffel and Adair Rolling Duffel bags help make it easier to keep the essentials together: • Practice outfit, plus an extra top • Cheer shoes and socks • Hair ties, bows, and a brush • Water bottle • A small towel • Deodorant or body spray • Snacks for a quick energy boost • Mini first aid kit For Creative Minds Who Carry More Than Just Books Not every after-school plan involves a uniform or a practice field. Some days are about ideas, sketching, writing, building, learning, and experimenting. The Bancroft Backpack understands that kind of rhythm: • A dedicated laptop compartment (fits up to 15") for digital work and creative tools. • Multiple compartments and interior organization for notebooks, art supplies, and everything in between. • A front pocket with built-in slips (because pens, pencils, and markers have a way of disappearing when you need them most). • Side pockets that are designed to actually fit water bottles and keep them snug. • Adjustable straps that make it comfortable from their first class of the day to their final after-school activity. It's structured but not rigid, functional but still expressive. Exactly what creative days call for. "I love this bag! I use this all the time! Super light easy to clean." ~ Samantha Less In Your Hands. More On Your Mind. Some parts of the day call for the essentials, not the entire locker. Walking into practice, grabbing a snack, meeting friends, and keeping valuables close during a competition are some of the times when this bag earns its place as the go-to choice. The Original Zip Hipster keeps things simple, smart, and stylish: • Three zippered compartments to keep phone, keys, and wallet from becoming one big mystery pile. • A lightweight design that's easy to carry from one activity to the next. • An adjustable strap, so she can wear it her way, hands-free. It's the bag for the in-between moments that still deserve a little style. Keep what you need within easy reach while everything else stays in the big bag. “It's a very handy bag! It holds all I need and is not overloaded.” ~ Judith Snacks & Hydration Matter, Too A long day needs more than a good attitude. Between class, practice, rehearsal, games, and the ride home, snacks and drinks should be part of the plan, not an afterthought. For everyday snacks, lunches, and quick fuel, the Lunch Bag keeps things compact and easy: • Compact, easy to carry, and designed with a food-safe, insulated lining. • Keeps meals and snacks fresh through long afternoons. • Simple, practical, and surprisingly essential. For longer days, outdoor activities, tournaments, or group snacks, the Cooler Backpack offers more room to work with: • Hands-free and built for movement, with insulated storage that keeps drinks and snacks cool. • Spacious enough for longer days, when one snack isn't going to cut it. • Durable and easy to bring along, wherever the day leads. We'll keep you prepared because hunger always has terrible timing. Her Day. Her Bag. Her Rules. There's no single version of after-school life. Some days run on schedules, uniforms, and practice times. Others are all improv, quick changes, and “Wait, where are my shoes?” That's the beauty of it. The right bag doesn't tell her how to show up. It simply keeps up with her gear, plans, style, and every version of herself she brings to the day. Find the Vera Bradley bag that fits her next big thing and everything she needs to bring with it. items.title: Bags Mom Will Actually Use (and Love) Every Day
items.summary: Being a mom means doing a hundred different things in one day. A mom might be a professional, a caregiver, a friend, a partner, a problem-solver, and a planner all before the sun sets. Her schedule can shift from school drop-offs to meetings to errands to downtime (if she's lucky), often without much warning. The best bags for moms don't just keep up, they make everything feel a little easier and more put-together. When it comes to Mother's Day, birthdays, holidays, or any-day gifts, it's all about finding those bags that are easy for a mom to use, organize, and love. The One She Reaches for Without Thinking Let's start with the bag that earns its spot by the door. The Original Zip Hipster is one of the best crossbody bags for moms that does everything right. Three zip compartments mean keys, phone, and wallet are all exactly where she expects them to be with no digging or drama. The longer adjustable strap gives her options, whether she's layering up or keeping it light. Bottom Line: This one keeps up and keeps things together whether she's running errands, navigating a crowded airport, or walking into a day she didn't fully plan. "It's a very handy bag! It holds all I need and is not overloaded." ~ Judith The Tote That Carries the Day (And Then Some) There's always more to carry. Six interior slip pockets mean everything has a place, including snacks, notebooks, chargers, and that one thing she always needs but never remembers until she does. The quilted cotton lining adds a comfortable, lived-in. It's the bag that moves from weekday to weekend without asking for a switch. Pro Tip: For the days when she wants the same energy, just a little lighter? Our Small Original Vera Tote steps in with the same thoughtful design... just in a more compact size! "Perfect size and I love all the pockets and compartments." ~ Dana The Travel Companion That Gets It Some bags say they're ready for travel, but this one actually is! The Pack-It-All Power Player Some trips are all about perfectly folded outfits and color-coded packing lists. Tournament travel is not one of them. This is where a bag that can handle multiple demands really earns its keep. Our Large Original Duffel is roomy enough for uniforms, extra layers, and that spare hoodie that always ends up saving the day. With a wide interior, three inside slip pockets, and easy-access exterior pockets, it keeps the essentials where you can actually find them. items.title: Girls Weekend Essentials: How to Pack for a Fun, Stress-Free Trip
items.summary: The itinerary is set. The playlist is locked. The group chat has officially reached "we should all wear this at brunch" levels of enthusiasm. Now comes the part that can make or break the vibe: packing. If you've ever stared at a bed covered in outfit options, wondering how this escalated so quickly, you're not alone. The secret to how to pack for a weekend getaway isn't bringing more; it's bringing smarter. Think mix-and-match outfits, shoes that won't betray you halfway through the night, a beauty kit that travels well, and a weekend bag that keeps everything in its place. Start With Your Girls Weekend Bag A girls trip moves fast. Coffee runs turn into shopping, shopping turns into sunset cocktails. Suddenly, someone suggests dancing. Your bag needs to keep up. Our Large Miramar Weekender is built for exactly that kind of trip. Spacious without feeling oversized, it's the kind of bag that makes packing feel easy instead of chaotic. With a roomy main compartment, a dedicated laptop pocket, and thoughtful interior pockets, it keeps your essentials organized without requiring a packing spreadsheet. Slip your tablet or laptop into the padded compartment, stash quick-grab items in the front slip pocket, and take advantage of the interior pockets to keep smaller things from wandering around the bottom of your bag. The Mix-and-Match Outfit Strategy Packing light doesn't mean packing boring. The trick is choosing pieces that work together in different ways. Here's an easy way to plan your outfits: • Two casual daytime outfits • One brunch-ready look • One "just in case we go somewhere nice" outfit • A lightweight layer for cool evenings • Comfortable shoes you can actually walk in When everything coordinates, you can pack fewer pieces while still having options. And yes, this strategy leaves room for an “I bought something cute, and now I need space to bring it home” situation. Your Beauty Routine, Travel Edition Keeping beauty products organized while traveling shouldn't feel like solving a puzzle. The Medium Cosmetic Bag (Dimensions: 9.0" w x 5.25" h x 3.25" d) gives you enough room for makeup, skincare, and toiletries while keeping everything contained and easy to find. Pair it with our Upright Product Organizer (Dimensions: 5.75" w x 8.75" h x 5.75" d), designed specifically to hold bottles upright so they don't spill or leak mid-trip. The structured design and elastic loops keep products in place, so you don't have to worry about dealing with any lotion explosions when you unpack. Together, they make your beauty routine feel just as organized on the road as it does at home. Chargers, Cords, and the Tangle You Didn't Sign Up For Between GPS duty, photos, group texts, restaurant reservations, and rideshares, your phone works overtime on a girls weekend. Enter our Cord Organizer, a compact lifesaver designed to keep chargers, earbuds, and cables neatly contained. Inside, mesh pockets make it easy to see what's where, while the zip closure keeps everything secure inside your bag. Dimensions: 8.5" w x 6.5" h x 2.0" d No more digging through your weekend bag looking for the one charger you swear you packed. A Going Out Bag That Doesn't Slow You Down When the group decides to wander a new neighborhood or squeeze in one more stop before heading back, you want something light and easy. Our Woodward Small Belt Bag (Dimensions: 7.5" w x 4.75" h x 2.0" d) keeps things hands-free while holding your essentials (phone, cards, keys, and lip balm) in a sleek, compact silhouette. Three interior card pockets and a key loop help keep everything secure, while the adjustable strap lets you wear it your way. Prefer something a little more classic? The Clip & Zip Wristlet (Dimensions: 6.0" w x 4.0" h x 0.5" d) is the perfect grab-and-go companion. It slips easily onto your wrist or clips inside your larger bag, keeping your cards and small essentials right where you need them. Sun Protection That Looks Good Doing It A girls weekend usually includes brunch patios, beach walks, or spontaneous sightseeing. Dall Polarized Sunglasses deliver style, comfort, and UV protection all in one. Polarized lenses reduce glare, while your choice of signature Vera Bradley prints adds a subtle design detail that makes them feel special. To keep them protected in your bag, tuck them into the Double Eye Case, which holds two pairs of glasses in one compact case. It's perfect if you travel with both sunglasses and reading glasses, or if your best friend inevitably forgets hers. The Girls Weekend Packing Checklist If you're wondering how to pack for a weekend getaway, this quick list keeps things streamlined: • Mix-and-match outfits • Comfortable walking shoes • A lightweight layer • Beauty essentials in travel-size containers • Phone chargers and headphones • Sunglasses and a case • Snacks and a reusable water bottle • A compact bag for exploring Pack it all inside your favorite girls weekend bag, and suddenly the whole trip feels easier. Now You Know How to Weekend With a smart bag, a few thoughtful organizers, and essentials that travel well, your girls weekend starts feeling effortless before you even leave the house! Browse our favorite weekend bags and travel accessories designed to keep everything stylishly in place. SHOP ALL WEEKEND BAGS & ACCESSORIES

items.title: The Original 100 Handbag: Why It Will Always Be Your Favorite
items.summary: Every brand has a beginning. Ours just happened to give way to a bag that became a forever favorite. The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag wasn’t designed to be iconic. It was designed to be carried every day, everywhere by women who had places to go and no interest in carrying something boring to get there. It was practical without looking practical. Pretty without trying too hard. Structured, but still soft enough to feel lived-in from day one. And maybe that’s why it stuck. This wasn’t just another Vera Bradley handbag. It was the one that proved you could have thoughtful organization, a timeless shape, and personality all in one bag. That’s exactly what makes it unforgettable! Why It Still Works (And Always Will) The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag isn’t trying to reinvent itself every season. It doesn’t need to. The proportions are right. The shape is right. The details are right. It’s roomy enough for what you actually carry, compact enough to never feel bulky. It’s the kind of bag you grab without thinking twice because you already know it works. Its handle drop is long enough to sit comfortably on your shoulder, yet easy to carry without the need for constant adjusting or tucking it under your arm. It’s subtle, but those details matter. You feel them in the way the bag moves with you. Plenty of Pockets for Everything You Need Every Day We’ve always believed a bag should make your day smoother, not more chaotic. Inside the Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag you’ll find five interior slip pockets. That means your phone isn’t hiding under your sunglasses and your keys aren’t always at the bottom of the bag. All of your essentials have a place. On the outside, you’ll find two slip pockets for the things you reach for constantly, like your phone, ID badge, or lip balm. And the zip closure keeps everything secure without ruining the clean lines of the bag. It’s a practical design made by people who actually carry handbags. Different Decades. Same Good Taste. The Original 100 Handbag was launched by Vera Bradley founders Patricia R. Miller and Barbara Bradley Baekgaard in 1982, back when bags were bland and colorful patterns were seldom found. Adding colorful patterns and prints to tote bags was a bold move that many found joyful. Although the Original 100 Handbag has plenty of history, it doesn’t feel stuck in the past. A new generation is discovering the Vera Bradley handbag that started it all. And they’re styling it their own way. With vintage denim, tailored blazers, sneakers, heels, or whatever feels right today. It works all of these looks because it doesn’t dictate. It’s not about nostalgia. It’s about confidence. It’s The Details That Matter Now that you know the vibe, let’s get into the specifics of this classic bag. What are the Dimensions of the Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag? It measures 11" wide x 5 ¾” high x 5 ¾” deep. It’s compact but roomy enough for your daily essentials. What is the Handle Drop? The handle drop is 13 ½”, making it easy to carry comfortably on your shoulder. How Many Pockets Does It Have? You’ll find five interior slip pockets for organization inside and two exterior slip pockets for quick-access items. It also features a zip closure to keep everything contained and secure while maintaining its classic silhouette. Is This a Good Everyday Bag? That’s exactly what it was designed for. It’s structured enough to look polished, practical enough to handle your real life, and timeless enough to carry for years. Plus, the bag is made with our signature quilted cotton which is durable and machine washable, all while looking great for years. The Original 100 Handbag: Fits Your Life and Not Just Your Outfit Trends are fun. We love them. But favorites? Favorites are different. Favorites are the bags you reach for without thinking. The ones that already know your routine. The ones that somehow look better the more you carry them. The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag isn’t trying to be the loudest bag in the room. It wants to be the one you trust. SHOP THE ORIGINAL 100 HANDBAG

items.title: One Tote. Three Lives. (Work, Weekend, Whatever!)
items.summary: If your hallway floor has ever looked like a support group for abandoned bags (work tote here, weekend bag there, mystery crossbody in the corner), you're not alone. Switching bags sounds reasonable in theory. In practice? It's a lot of re-packing, a lot of forgetting, and way too much "Wait, where did I put that?" Here's a better idea: one tote that stays the same, and a system that changes with you. Because you don't need a different bag for every version of your life. You need a smarter way to carry it all. The One-Tote Philosophy (A Love Letter to Less Switching) Your tote isn't the problem. The chaos inside it is. Instead of playing musical bags, think of your tote as home base. The structure stays consistent. The only changes are the pouches and accessories inside, with each one assigned a specific role for a certain day. This is how to organize a tote bag without turning it into a second job. One tote. Three grab-and-go kits. No overthinking required. Choose Your Foundation: The Tote That Does It All Your tote is the anchor. It's the piece that shows up every day, holds everything together, and still looks like you've got it handled, even when the day gets messy. Original Vera Tote This is the classic carryall, refined. A secure zip closure, a longer strap drop that's comfortable all day, and just enough interior and exterior pockets to support an organized system without overcomplicating it. It's polished enough for work, relaxed enough for weekends, and spacious enough to hold multiple pouches and more. If you want one tote that truly moves from Monday to Sunday without blinking, this is it. Choose the Original Vera Tote (15.0" w x 14.5" h x 6.0" d) when you need to tuck in an extra pouch, or a Small Original Vera Tote when the daily essentials will do it. Hathaway Tote Softer structure, effortless style, and an interior that plays beautifully with organizer pouches. The Hathaway Tote has an open design makes it easy to customize your setup and is perfect if you like a flexible system that adapts as fast as your plans do. This tote shines when your days blend together: errands, meetings, lunch dates, repeat. Plus, new Hathaway Totes are reversible so you can change your style whenever the mood strikes you! Choose the Hathaway Tote (13.75" w x 13.0" h x 6.25" d) when you need to carry it all or the Small Hathaway Tote (11.08" w x 11.25" h x 4.5" d) when you want to leave the big wallet at home. Spacious (17.0" w x 15.0" h x 6.0" d) without being bulky, it's designed to keep everything in its place: work essentials, personal items, and the extras you carry because your day rarely looks the same twice. A zip laptop pocket keeps tech protected and easy to access, while multiple interior pockets help your organizer pouches stay exactly where you want them. The secure zip closure means everything stays put, even when your schedule is full, and your tote is too. Let the Tote Stay. Let the Kits Do the Work. Once you've found your tote, the rest gets refreshingly simple. This is where your organization system stops being about perfection and starts being about intention. Instead of rearranging your entire bag every time your plans shift, you build a few smart kits that live inside it. The tote stays constant. The contents adapt. These kits are what make your bag work harder without asking more of you, ready to step in, step out, and keep up with whatever version of the day you're walking into next. Kit #1: The Always On-the-Go Kit This kit lives in your tote full-time. It's the reason you're never caught off guard. What goes inside: • Small Pouch from the 3 Pouch Organizer Set: Lip balm, hand cream, hair ties, bandages, or whatever experience has taught you to keep close. It's quiet. It's dependable. It earns its spot every single day. "Great accessory to any of the Vera Bradley bags." ~ Lea Kit #2: The Work Kit This kit handles your workday so your tote doesn't have to work overtime. What goes inside: • Laptop Pouch: Cushioned protection that slips easily into your tote and keeps your tech secure and easy to grab. • Cord Organizer: A place for chargers, earbuds, and cables that refuses to become a tangled mess. • Medium Pouch from our 3 Pouch Organizer Set: For notebooks, pens, and the essentials you reach for daily. When work is done, the entire kit comes out in one move. Clean break. No digging. "I use these EVERY DAY to keep my purse organized!" ~ Hannah Kit #3: The Weekend Kit Weekends don't need structure, but your bag does. What goes inside: • Large Pouch from the 3 Pouch Organizer Set: Roomy enough for day-trip extras, travel essentials, or whatever you throw in "just in case." • Travel Pill Case: Keeps your routine intact without taking up space or attention. Drop this kit into any of the totes above and suddenly your everyday bag is weekend-ready. No repacking. No second-guessing. "Picked a bright color since everything tends to get lost in my big purse. Easy to find and easy to use." ~ Evelyn Why Tote Bag Organizer Pouches Change Everything Here's the truth: organization only works if it's fast. Tote bag organizer pouches let you: • Swap modes without emptying your bag. • Keep essentials grouped by purpose. • Stop losing time (and patience) to clutter. This system works because it respects how you actually live each day. This isn't about being perfectly organized, it's about feeling prepared without trying too hard!

One for snacks, one for cords and chargers, and one for the things you always forget until you don't have them, like a pen and small notebook, and the lip balm you can't leave at home. The three sizes let you sort your essentials in a way that makes sense to you. Zip closures mean nothing escapes, whether it's tucked in your tote bag or backpack. Stylish, practical, endlessly useful, and proof that being prepared doesn't have to look boring. "Great for organizing items to be carried in larger bag or pack. Light weight yet strong material." ~ Sandi Delays Don't Define the Journey. You Do. Flights change and plans shift. But when your bag is packed with intention, a delay becomes a pause instead of a problem. A well-built delay kit keeps you comfortable, collected, and ready for whatever the terminal throws your way. Because being prepared isn't about control, it's about confidence! You move through the chaos with your own rhythm, your own style, and travel bags that understand the assignment. Whether you're headed on a city escape, a beach retreat, or a countryside getaway, these thoughtfully designed overnight bags for women ensure you travel effortlessly while keeping your essentials organized. These stylish and functional picks offer just the right amount of space, smart compartments, and effortless portability, so you can focus on the adventure ahead—not on juggling your luggage. "Perfect size for a long weekend, and so many pockets for utility!" ~ Eleanor Spacious yet carry-on compliant, this bag offers dedicated compartments for all your essentials, including a zip laptop pocket for work-on-the-go moments.
